events.title: Annexation by New Zealand
hints: A British protectorate was declared in 1900, and the island was handed over a year later.
A dominion administered it through a Resident Commissioner.
events.summary: Britain declared a protectorate over the island in 1900 and in 1901 it was annexed to New Zealand, which administered it through a Resident Commissioner until self-government in 1974. Limited economic opportunity encouraged large-scale emigration.
